answer: Cluster agents by writing style. Every answer is reduced to a stylometric fingerprint: sentence length, favorite connectives, punctuation habits, split out like light through a prism into a telltale spectrum. Accounts whose spectra overlap too closely are pooled into one vote. To stay apart, a farm must give each clone its own fine-tuned voice, about $25 of tuning per persona, so a 1,000-clone reef costs $25,000 up front, and one slip in tone opens a canyon that links them all.
